'''Korven''', codenamed '''Cipher Fourteen''', was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Cipher Agent]] of [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] living during the [[Galactic War]].

==Biography==
During her service for the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] she earned multiple commendations, but was also reprimanded for using methods too extreme even for the Sith standards. Her reputation as a ruthless, ambitious, and amoral individual eventually backfired when other agents started to refuse working with her for fear of back-stabbing, leading to a stall in her career. It led to her defecting and later being suspected in several anti-Imperial terrorist acts.<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|type=codex|Alliance Intelligence Report: Major Korven}}</ref>

Following the death of [[Empress/Legends|Empress]] [[Vaylin]] and formation of the [[Eternal Alliance]] in [[3630 BBY]], Korven re-emerged as a leader of a rogue faction of Sith defectors. Operating from the [[Vanguard Station]], they began targeting and destroying nearby Alliance outposts. This eventually prompted the Alliance to [[Battle of Vanguard Station|retaliate]] and in defending the Vanguard Station against the assault, Korven was killed.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[Major/Legends|Major]] Korven appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' during the final boss fight of "Fractured" Uprising.
